items.quote: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
items.claim: Moses told the LORD that the people cannot ascend mount Sinai because God had commanded them to establish boundaries and sanctify it

items.quote: thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
items.claim: God commanded them to establish boundaries around the mount and sanctify it

items.quote: The people cannot come up to mount Sinai
items.claim: The people were unable to ascend mount Sinai
